Question: Suppose that a test statistic has associated with it a p-value of 0.08. Which one of the following statements is true?
(i) If the size of the test were exactly 8%, we would be indifferent between rejecting and not rejecting the null hypothesis
(ii) The null would be rejected if a 10% size of test were used
(iii) The null would not be rejected if a 1% size of test were used
(iv) The null would be rejected if a 5% size of test were used.
Options: A. (iii) and (iv) only
B. (i) and (iv) only
C. (i), (ii), and (iii) only
D. (i) and (ii) only
E. (i) and (iii) only
F. (i), (ii), (iii), and (iv).
G. (ii), (iii), and (iv) only
H. (ii) and (iii) only
I. (ii) and (iv) only
J. (i), (iii), and (iv) only
Answer: Let's think step by step and then finish your answer with 'the answer is (X)' where X is the correct letter choice.assistant
response:
Step 1: Understand the given information
The test statistic has a p-value of 0.08.

Step 2: Recall the definition of a p-value
The p-value is the probability of observing a result as extreme or more extreme than the one observed, assuming that the null hypothesis is true.

Step 3: Determine the relationship between the p-value and the size of the test
A smaller p-value indicates stronger evidence against the null hypothesis, while a larger p-value indicates weaker evidence.

Step 4: Analyze each statement
(i) If the size of the test were exactly 8%, we would be indifferent between rejecting and not rejecting the null hypothesis: This statement is true, as a p-value of 0.08 is equal to the size of the test.

(ii) The null would be rejected if a 10% size of test were used: This statement is false, as a p-value of 0.08 is less than 10%, so the null would not be rejected.

(iii) The null would not be rejected if a 1% size of test were used: This statement is false, as a p-value of 0.08 is greater than 1%, so the null would be rejected.

(iv) The null would be rejected if a 5% size of test were used: This statement is true, as a p-value of 0.08 is less than 5%, so the null would be rejected.

Step 5: Choose the correct answer
The correct answer is (B) (i) and (iv) only.
